scenes.basis: 13:1 "Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers"
13:4-5 "they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus. When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God's word in the Jewish synagogues"
13:6 "When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew"
13:13 "Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia"

13:14 "But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day" - 13:51 "came to Iconium" is the departure leg; Iconium becomes the setting at 14:1
